method: Built-in image_gen; source sheets retained unchanged.
snow_material: Create one seamless square ground material texture for the winter Act 1 of a dark fantasy isometric action RPG. Orthographic directly overhead flat surface, no perspective, no horizon, no objects, no text. Fine wind-packed pale silver-blue snow, soft irregular shallow drifts, delicate wind ripples and a few tiny slate pebbles barely exposed. Overall light medium value cool winter ivory with subdued steel-blue shadows; 90 percent snow cover, natural nonuniform mottling at broad scale but subtle low contrast to keep game characters readable. Painterly realistic hand-painted late-1990s gothic game environment quality, restrained texture. Absolutely no trees, footprints, snowflakes, big rocks, tiled grid, diamond outline, cast shadows or vignette. All four edges seamlessly repeat. Entire image filled with snow. This is a production terrain albedo material.
nature_atlas: Production environment SPRITE ATLAS for a dark fantasy isometric winter action RPG. Exactly SIX separate complete objects in a precise 3 columns by 2 rows grid, evenly spaced in six equal cells. Transparent background, real alpha, no ground plane, no scenery backdrop, no text or labels. 1536 square canvas if possible. Each object fits wholly inside its cell with a generous transparent gutter. Hand-painted realistic late-1990s gothic game art, crisp silhouette, cold slate stone and deep blue-green evergreen foliage with pale silver snow on upward faces, lighting upper left. Orthographic 2:1 isometric game camera, approximately 30 degrees down. Row 1: cell 1 one tall mature snow-covered fir tree; cell 2 asymmetric group of three slender snow-dusted alpine fir trees with one taller tree and two shorter; cell 3 one broad ancient crooked snow-covered pine. Row 2: cell 1 one massive jagged vertical slate rock outcrop with sparse snow on its ledges, tallest shape slightly left; cell 2 one wide cluster of angular layered snow-dusted boulders with a low windswept shrub; cell 3 one broken black stone standing pillar with a small cluster of frosted bare branches. Roots and rocks emerge directly from transparent background; no oval white snow carpet, no island, no circular pedestal, no tile shape. Natural tiny soft contact shadows only. Each sprite fully isolated. No people, buildings, borders, glow, symbols or interface.
